column1: Order under Section 27(1) (b) read with Section 25A
BY virtue of powers vested in me by section 27(1 )(b) read with Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I,
Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education having obtained a report
under Section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of the Nagananda International Institute for Buddhist Studies (Pvt) Limited
a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 and bearing Registration Number PV 94125
and located at Manelwatta, Bollegala, Kelaniya, being recognized as a Degree Awarding Institute do by this Order, amend
the Schedule I to the Order made under the said Act, and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1944/2 of December 07,
